assets.initial_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a sophisticated editorial identity presentation board for a warm, trustworthy community encyclopedia about Odisha, India. Brand name exactly "Utkala". Descriptor exactly "A living encyclopedia of Odisha". This is a new original concept, not official Odisha government branding. Landscape presentation board, warm ivory #F5EBDD, lots of quiet space and rigorous layout. A confident bookish dark red serif Utkala wordmark and a spare simple emblem: two open-book pages shaped subtly like paired boat sails above a shallow curved hull, one integrated idea, no sun, no gear, no temple silhouette. Palette swatches labeled with exact HEX values #8F2435 #F5EBDD #24211F #C9923E #245C59. Top-left generous brand lockup. Right a beautiful large flat hand-painted illustration referencing the dense organic linework and framed storytelling associated with Odisha Pattachitra, interpreted as contemporary original art: a sailing boat, palm fronds, birds, little terracotta food vessels and cloth forms in a calm coastal landscape. Keep this art distinct from the spare logo. Bottom small application previews: a cream editorial article card titled "Meet the makers", a maroon contributor card titled "Share what you know", and a thin hand-drawn floral border. Warmth, precision, cultural care, confident art direction, restrained decoration, tangible brush and handmade paper texture. Beautiful real graphic design, not a photo of stationery. No invented Odia script, no deity images, no government seal, no generic mandala. Only specified short English text and palette hex labels, no filler text. No claim this is a traditional artisan-made artifact.
